sources.finding: didDeactivate returns without calling emulatorBridge.deactivateInput when game views exist but none has keyboard focus (lines 444-452). pause/resume (188-226) do not explicitly reset inputs or reconcile current keyboard state.

For a non-sustained input, deactivate removes activatedInputs before notifying receivers. Duplicate deactivation is ignored if already absent. A receiver that drops this release can diverge from the controller state.
willResignActive queues pause. The inspected pause/resume path delegates to EmulatorCore without explicit input reconciliation.
hasKeyboardFocus uses an OS scene property with fallbacks; its actual value during this lock trial was not measured.

observations.inference: If release is delivered while the game scene lacks keyboard focus, the controller state may clear while emulator input remains active. Returning to foreground and pressing/releasing RIGHT again can deliver a new release and clear it.
